reason: I plan my meals before the trip from Japanese guidebooks and blogs, and this place is not on my list. On a short holiday in Honolulu I would rather spend my meals on places I already know are good, not a Korean restaurant I just walked past.
objection: I do not know if I will like cold noodle soup made from arrowroot, and nobody I trust has told me it is worth it. Paying $18.95 plus tax for something I may not finish feels like a waste of a holiday meal.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it recommended in a Japanese guidebook or by a Japanese blogger or Instagram account, with photos of the naengmyeon, especially on a very hot afternoon.
